title: INDICLLMSUITE: A BLUEPRINT FOR CREATING PRE-TRAINING AND FINE-TUNING DATASETS FOR INDIAN LANGUAGES

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the disparity in NLP resources by comparing dataset sizes (token counts, document lengths) and evaluating language identification accuracy across 22 Indian languages in comparison to existing English-centric and multilingual datasets (e.g., mC4, OSCAR).

bias_targets.target: Multiple demographic biases (Ethnic/Regional, Age, Disability, Sexual orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Developing a 'Toxic Matrix' taxonomy to generate synthetic toxic prompts targeting specific demographic groups (e.g., regional Indian identities, specific age groups, disabled children, heterosexuals) to train and evaluate model safety alignment and safe refusal responses.
